summary: Migrate existing arrangement placements to ordered memberships without changing canonical winners

replay.detail: Retained membership.migrate arrangement operations activate v2 on the same identity. Replay translates historical placement claims directly into pair heads with their original canonical keys/revisions; no immutable claim is rewritten. Historical placement register projections remain migration-boundary inputs, not active v2 placement authority.

schema.detail: Adds the standalone membership.migrate arrangement operation and a retained membership-authority register within the existing arrangement projection. No database table or numeric schema version change. Generated clients expose the operation; capability arrangement-placement-migration version 1 identifies supporting daemons.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules move from 14 to 15 to distinguish migration-aware arrangement/membership witnesses; no claim-drop rule changes. Shared projection identity is st3.shared-projections.arrangement-placement-migration.v1. Upgrade all participating daemons before sealing these checkpoints.

compatibility.detail: Migration atomically switches reads to an explicit folder-only v2 body and membership pages/windows. Strict v1-only readers refuse v2 rather than seeing empty placements. Local subject.place writes are refused after cutover; late replicated legacy placement claims route into the same pair LWW reducer and never revert authority. Name/owner/folders/tombstones/keys and original real-actor provenance remain intact. Older daemons may quarantine the new operation; do not migrate with mixed deployed writers.

downtime.detail: Explicit migration runs atomically in the existing SQLite writer transaction; deployed interruption/latency has not been measured.

manual.detail: Discover arrangement-placement-migration capability, select the existing canonical arrangement, then submit arrangement.edit with operations:[{op:membership.migrate}] and no version field. Observe body.version==2 before exclusively using membership reads/actions. Exact action retries reuse receipts; independent reruns preserve newer pair edits. See docs/st3/client-v0/README.md#migrating-existing-placement-authority.

recovery.detail: The marker and backfill commit together: a crash exposes v1 or complete v2, and retries/rebuild reconstruct original winners from retained claims. Preserve a pre-upgrade backup. Binary downgrade does not reverse cutover and has not been verified; roll forward or restore a consistent backup and matching binary.
